exposure: manual vacuum aspiration (MVA) followed by curettage
outcome: occurrence of post-molar gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN)
cohort: 198 patients with hydatidiform mole treated at Nagoya University Hospital between 2004 and 2023, of whom 106 underwent D&C and 60 underwent MVA followed by curettage.
finding: MVA followed by curettage is a viable and equally effective approach compared to D&C for treating molar pregnancy, showing similar surgical duration, blood loss, and time to onset of post-molar GTN.
